answer: An equivocation-proof bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and files a meadow-plot claim, quill-signed, on the public cedar registry. Each epoch auditors replay the cedar registry: a quill key signing two claims is equivocation, so both bonds burn, and a rented-quill ring fails too. Fees rise per claim, first 40, then 40+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, paying 40.
